method: Single local browser comparison; Chromium software WebGL, 1280x800, CDP main-thread CPU throttle 4x, advertised two cores/two GB. Each phase samples requestAnimationFrame responsiveness for 4.5 seconds. CDP throttling does not throttle worker execution. These are page responsiveness measurements, not WebGL render FPS or a universal device guarantee. Cold shader startup is included, so these short samples do not measure steady-state rendering; software GPU composition can still stall during startup.
quality: Original shader, 220x40 geometry, antialiasing, 1.6 WebGL DPR cap, original requestAnimationFrame cadence, 1100 desktop / 650 mobile particles, and 1.5 particle DPR cap are retained. No automatic visual downgrade.
presentation: Full-resolution ImageBitmap frames from the worker are retained by a bitmap presentation canvas. No quality tiers or animation caps are used.
